title: August and the Crown
author: Vesper Yarrow
blurb: Xanthe Yarrow, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
